title: finding: existing projects cannot `npm install @objectstack/plugin-auth` or `@objectstack/metadata-core` on npm 10 since vitest@4.1.12 (`edgesOut`); metadata-core's own optional `vitest` peer is one path in
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect at a public door, measured. **Class (a):** a user-visible install failure. `reach:` `npm install @objectstack/plugin-auth@latest`, and separately `npm install @objectstack/metadata-core@latest`, in an empty project on npm 10.9.9, the npm Node 22 bundles.

**Filed by** the `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163) · `os-sales` · `session_016PVjjuVPte5XEJvaQx1E4t`. It comes from the dev's `out_of_scope_findings` on #23788 (PR #23799). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** triage routes it. Two owners are plausible:
- the seat owning `@objectstack/metadata-core`'s manifest, for its optional `vitest: ^4.0.0` peer;
- the docs/devx side, for the user remedy text.

## Measured (by #23788's dev, 2026-10-16)

- Each install above exits 1 with `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')` on npm 10.9.9; npm 11.21.1 installs both.
- **The entry paths:**
  - better-auth@1.7.3's optional `vitest` peer (`^2 || ^3 || ^4`), which is upstream;
  - `@objectstack/metadata-core`'s OWN optional `vitest: ^4.0.0` peer.
  - Both lead npm 10 to `vitest@4.1.12` (published 2026-10-15T14:51Z). It peers `@vitest/browser-webdriverio ^4.1.11`, whose only match, 4.1.11, peers `vitest: 4.1.11` exactly. npm 10's arborist crashes on that contradiction.
- **Not fixable by our packages alone:** the better-auth path is upstream, so plugin-auth stays affected whatever metadata-core declares. The user remedies today are npm 11, or a root `"overrides": { "vitest": "~4.0.0" }`; the latter is the shape PR #23799 ships in the blank template.

## Questions for the owner

1. Why does `@objectstack/metadata-core` declare an optional `vitest` peer at all? Who reads it at runtime? If nothing does, dropping it removes one of the two paths in.
2. Should the user-facing docs (install / troubleshooting) name the npm-10 remedy until upstream publishes a coherent vitest peer set? Re-measure first: `npm view @vitest/browser-webdriverio versions`, `npm view vitest dist-tags`.

## Executable criterion

- Either `npm install @objectstack/metadata-core@<next>` passes on npm 10.9.9 (its own peer path removed or narrowed, measured), or the card records why the peer stays.
- The remedy for `plugin-auth` on npm 10 is written where an installing user reads it, or the card records the upstream fix with the reading.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included, at this filing:
- `metadata-core optional peer vitest npm 10 install crash plugin-auth better-auth vitest 4.1.12`: 5 hits.
  - #23788 (open) is the CI half: the probe and the blank template.
  - #22912 (closed) is the CLI range, before this trigger.
  - #22418, #20242 and #16813 are unrelated.

Dedupe words: npm 10 edgesOut plugin-auth; metadata-core vitest optional peer; vitest 4.1.12 browser-webdriverio; existing project npm install crash.
